what: Gregar's records of Falzar's five Gigas (302, 306, 308, 309, 310: LibraryFlags 0x18) give each the icon, picture and palette of Gregar's Giga of its library number (HubBatc ColForce's), and Gregar holds none of their own; BN5's Team Colonel holds BassAnly's, BigHook's and CrossDiv's. The core's copy now draws BN5's for those three where its ROM is read and BN6's blank record's art for the rest (src/core/chips.c other_giga; docs/rom/chips.md, The other version's Gigas' art; issue #731).
